method: grid search +/-200 m step 2 m minimising the MAD of DEM(x+dx, y+dy) - elev_geoid over MMGIS drive ends inside dem_1m
sign: (dx, dy) is added to the MMGIS rover position (analysis CRS, m east/north) to land on the DEM; residual = DEM - rover elevation (m)
residuals_position: MMGIS drive-end lon/lat as published (before the shift)
